description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a protecting law and order press conference in Fayetteville. Michael was joined by Sheriff Wayne Coats of Harnett County and Aaron Meredith (Candidate for Harnett County Sheriff) to discuss Roy Cooper’s failed leadership, and how he released 4,200 violent criminals into North Carolina communities to wreak havoc.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts Protecting Law and Order Press Conference in Fayetteville – Michael Whatley for Senate
